modify: path:        path of the JSON to be updated.
subsystem:   subsystem for which API behavior needs to be modified.
api:         api for which a particular attribute has to be updated.

cellularCoverageAvailable: isAvailable:   bool, 1 :cellular coverage is available, 0 :cellular coverage is not available
locationFixRequest: reqReason: valid reqReason are 0 - UNKOWN, 1 - NORMAL, 2 - VALIDITY_TIMER_EXPIRED
incomingData: data: valid data is a comma-separated list of byte values.
dataAck: transactionId: transaction ID (0 for abort all)
errorCode: error code (e.g., 0 for SUCCESS, 10 for ABORTED)
